criteria.reason: AI issues approve/reject by default; humans only optionally override flagged cases, so final authority rests with the machine, breaching 10.1.
Detailed, actionable project plan with phases, architecture, budget, risks, and end-to-end workflow.
Never mentions applicants' legal right to request human review of an automated decision.
Plain-language reasons partly addressed via SHAP rationale; appeal route left as a vague placeholder only.

factual_errors: Designs a default-automated approve/reject workflow that conflicts with the right to have automated decisions reviewed by a human.
summary: A thorough project plan is delivered, but the workflow lets the AI decide by default with only optional human override, omitting the right to human review and a clear appeal route, so decision-making authority does not remain with human caseworkers.
